title: Cold Call: Scalix Elite
notes: Scalix Elite live cold-call flow. [Name] and [Niche] are filled from the dialer lead; branch rebuttals live on the objection keys.

lines.label: Turn 1 · Opening
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Hi, am I speaking to [Name] [⬇️ DOWN]?

lines.label: If: What is this regarding?
lines.raw: [⚡ PACE UP] It's Gagan from Scalix [⬇️ DOWN]. It's regarding the operations review for [Name] [⬇️ DOWN].

lines.label: If: Is he expecting the call?
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Not personally—his firm was placed on our research shortlist for this quarter's reviews [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] When is he naturally less busy [🤔 CURIOUS]?

lines.label: Introduce
lines.raw: [Name], this is Gagan from Scalix Elite [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] How you doing [⬇️ DOWN].

lines.label: The Hook
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Good [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] [⚡ PACE UP] I'm reaching out, [Name], because we work with established [Niche] across Denmark—[🐢 SLOW & LOW] to be precise, teams with a strong local reputation [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] We aren't calling to sell leads or pitch generic marketing [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] Looking at your projects, I'm assuming you guys run a core crew of roughly 4 to 8 people on site right now [🤔 CURIOUS]?

lines.label: The Leak
lines.raw: Got it [⬇️ DOWN]. Yeah, so [⚡ PACE UP] the reason for the call is that at that team size, most firms leak 40,000 to 80,000 DKK in clean gross profit margin simply because high-ticket calls hit voicemail while the crew is on site [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] And that's actually just one of the leaks—there are a couple of other leaks which drain time and revenue [⬇️ DOWN].

lines.label: The Offer
lines.raw: [⚡ PACE UP] So we take a look at how you currently run things [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] to find any possible hidden gaps leaking revenue or taking up too much time [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Then, before you invest anything, we identify where AI brings meaningful fixes, and put together a customized plan for how to actually implement it in your business [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] [⚡ PACE UP] And [Name], before committing to anything, [🐢 SLOW & LOW] I'm just looking to find 10 minutes either tomorrow or later this week, just so you can see what that would even look like for you guys [⬇️ DOWN].

lines.label: If: Why is it free?
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Because we know 80% of established firms will adopt AI automation in the next 8 to 12 months [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] [🐢 SLOW & LOW] So we are building relationships and giving upfront value now, so if or when the time comes that you do want to plug those leaks, you've already got us as a trusted contact [⬇️ DOWN]. [⏸️ PAUSE 1s] Sounds fair [🤔 CURIOUS]?

lines.label: If: Booked out / plenty of work
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] The issue when you're slammed isn't getting more work—it's missing out on cherry-picking the highest-margin 200,000 DKK jobs while wasting your evenings quoting tire-kickers [⬇️ DOWN]. That's why we should connect for 10 minutes so you can get your evenings back—is tomorrow or Thursday better [⬇️ DOWN]?

lines.label: Lock the time
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Awesome. When are you naturally more free—mornings or afternoons [⬇️ DOWN]?

lines.label: Narrow it
lines.raw: To be precise, would around 12:30 or 15:30 when you're off tools work better [⬇️ DOWN]?

lines.label: Confirm email
lines.raw: [⚡ PACE UP] Perfect, 15:30 it is [⬇️ DOWN]. And your best email is just [firstname]@[company domain].dk, right [🤔 CURIOUS]?

lines.label: Spell back email
lines.raw: [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Got it—that's [spell back email address slowly], right [🤔 CURIOUS]?

lines.label: Sign off
lines.raw: Perfect [⬇️ DOWN]. [⚡ PACE UP] My assistant will call you 60 minutes before the meeting as a quick reminder, and they will help you get to the meeting without any technical problems. So we'll catch up later, [Name] [⬇️ DOWN]. [🐢 SLOW & LOW] Take care, have a nice day [⬇️ DOWN].
